text:
Asha: Hey team — I pushed updates to the routing-guard PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/482 (addressed the review comments about fallback ordering and added a small unit test). PTAL when you have a minute.
Liam: Thanks — will take a quick pass now. did you run the smoke script locally?
Asha: yep ran `./scripts/smoke-routing.sh` and it passes locally, output snippet below:
```
$ ./scripts/smoke-routing.sh
✔ routing guard unit tests: 12 passed
✔ integration sanity: ok (latency within threshold)
```
Kai: quick question — the new guard interacts with shard fallback. did you add the override flag for canary? we need that for the Dedicated rollout.
Asha: good catch — added `--allow-fallback-override` behind a feature flag and wired it to the rollout config. also added a small e2e that flips the flag in the test harness.
Liam: Code LGTM except one tiny nit on the arg parsing (commented inline). can you squash the fix? then i'll approve.
Asha: fixed and pushed a follow-up commit to squash. also updated CHANGELOG with the guard rationale.
dev-ci: CI passed — all checks green (unit/integration/e2e). build 2026-03-19T18:12:02Z.
Priya: eyeballing now. if Liam approves i'll queue this for merge at 15:00 PT so we can reserve the canary slot. sounds good?
Liam: approved — nit fixed, tests look good. :rocket:
Priya: LGTM. Asha — I'll take merge custodian and schedule canary at 15:00 PT.
Asha: thank you! I'll monitor canary and post results here. :thumbsup:
